title: My fully AI-made game just hit 2,300 players and 1,070+ hours played in just 2 days!
author: Class_Muted
selftext:
It's been a wild ride. Since launching [Impact](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1x0vly5/i_finally_made_my_childhood_dream_anime_game/) a couple of days ago, the reception has been mind-blowing for me. It's already hit 1,070+ hours played across 2,300 players, hundreds of thousands of views on socials, and it even got reposted by ThreeJS!

I've been improving the game consistently and adding what players are asking for, couch co-op, more fighters and phone optimisations, etc.

Along the way I also built PlayerTwo which initially started as a place to host my own games, but it's already grown to 2,500 users! So I thought about opening it up to other indie devs as a place to bring in gamers, devs, and this new generation/evolution of games we're seeing together. How it works is:

1) You can publish for free or behind a paywall, with or without a time-limited demo, offer discounts, bundles, etc.  
  
2) Host the game yourself or through PlayerTwo (I've set up Multiplayer support through the SDK and some useful little offerings)

3) Submit and publish the game yourself or have your agent do it through the MCP

4) Raise money through the launchpad if you want to expand the game, build out your demo

And many many more little details and features I always felt were missing from game stores.  


Would love to have you guys's awesome games there or just hear your feedback on the platform!  
Check out the game and the platform here: [PlayerTwo.lol](http://PlayerTwo.lol)
